name: 微信老版本
tagline: 微信 3.2.1 老版本，给带不动新版微信的老电脑用
taglineEn: WeChat 3.2.1 for older PCs that cannot run the current version
description: 微信 3.2.1，Windows 版微信的老版本安装包。基础聊天、图片与文件收发、群聊等主流功能都在，能正常登录使用；体积比 4.x 版小得多，对 CPU、内存的要求也低，适合教室里那些装不上新版微信、或者装上新版就卡的旧电脑。注意：微信官方已停止为 3.x 版本推送更新，部分新功能不可用；如果机器性能允许，建议优先用站内的微信新版。
descriptionEn: WeChat 3.2.1 is an older Windows installer. Basic chat, image and file transfer, and group chat still work and sign-in works normally. It is much smaller than 4.x and has lower CPU and memory requirements, making it suitable for older classroom PCs that cannot install or run the current WeChat. Note: Tencent no longer updates 3.x, so some new features are unavailable; use the current WeChat from this site when the hardware allows.
author: 腾讯
